methodology.note: Rule-contract reconciliation treats NET001 and NET002 as alternative states: NET001 for broad/dynamic destinations, NET002 when outbound capability exists but destination constraint remains unresolved.

agreements: Broad MCP surface and privileged in-repository MCP tools are structurally discovered.

mismatches.detail: FastAgent decorator server bindings are not propagated into effective MCP authority; AGT053 findings are unattributed (agent=null) despite source-level per-agent server lists.
Unpinned package runners in fastagent.config.yaml, including an explicit @latest MCP package, do not produce AGT050.
Four findings originate from application-support MCP-builder code rather than the primary runtime path; they should remain distinguishable from runtime authority.

agreements: Arbitrary model-selected URL reachability is reported as NET001.
reviewer_corrections: The blind review initially expected both NET001 and NET002. Built-in semantics make these alternative states; NET001 is the correct finding when a broad/dynamic destination is observed.

agreements: The ADK root agent is detected.

mismatches.detail: Source binds ALL_TOOLS = BANKING_TOOLS + OBSERVABILITY_TOOLS (13 tools), but HorusTrace recovers only one tool and emits no authority findings.
ADK001, AGT022 and CAP005 cannot fire because imported list composition is not resolved into effective agent authority.

agreements: No destructive SQL finding is emitted even though sql_executor_tool exists in source; it is not bound to the graph. This is an important effective-authority precision success.

mismatches.detail: Streamlit chat input reaches a LangGraph compiled with MemorySaver checkpointer, but no PATH007 is built. The rule catalogue explicitly includes agent memory/checkpoint writes; whether in-memory MemorySaver should count remains a product-semantics decision.
Scanner structural tool count exceeds the two source-effective ToolNode bindings, but this does not currently create privileged findings.

agreements: LangGraph principal and local stdio MCP construction are recovered.
unresolved: The MCP implementation is an absolute external JavaScript path not present in the repository, so privileged/state-changing MCP authority cannot be source-proven.
AGT052 was only inferred in the blind review and is not treated as a confirmed miss.

agreements: Custom model/tool loop principal is recognized.
Dynamic remote destination NET001 and unrestricted remote catalogue AGT032 are recovered.
AGT031 is correctly absent because the observed default endpoint is HTTPS.

mismatches.detail: The streamable-HTTP client is constructed with no auth parameter and headers only Accept/User-Agent, yet MCP authentication remains unknown and AGT030 is missed.

agreements: In-repository MCP servers and process-executing tools are discovered; AGT020 captures process execution risk.

mismatches.detail: MCPClient implements a source-proven Gemini model -> list_tools -> function_call -> call_tool loop, but no agent is created and no MCP authority is bound to a principal.
File/workspace-writing MCP operations do not produce AGT022.

AGT053 is documented as a bound-MCP rule, yet three AGT053 findings are emitted with agent=null. With caller-selected sys.argv server binding, exact effective binding is unresolved and should not be promoted to an unconditional bound-MCP finding.

agreements: Effective authority matches the four runtime function tools.
Inactive @upstash/context7-mcp@latest constructor is correctly not promoted to an effective MCP server or AGT050 finding.
reviewer_corrections: NET001, not NET001+NET002, is the expected network state when arbitrary/dynamic URL authority is source-proven.

mismatches.detail: Model-callable GitHub ingest and Tavily crawl/scrape accept URL arguments without a destination allowlist, but no NET001 is emitted.

agreements: No privileged findings are fabricated from adjacent MCP code that is not bound to the reviewed agent system.

mismatches.detail: demo() source creates at least future_analyst and strategic_planner through AgentOrchestrator.create_agent, while the scanner represents one agent principal.
Twenty-one MCP servers from adjacent repository subsystems are structurally visible despite no effective binding to the reviewed principals; zero findings mitigates security-impact noise.

agreements: State-changing Jira/task tools are recognized by AGT022/AGT040.
Combined read/write authority CAP005 is recovered.

mismatches.detail: Interactive Click CLI input flows to agent.run_sync and source-proven state-changing tools, but no PATH002 is built.
Eleven of twelve source-declared @agent.tool functions are recovered.

notes: NET002 is plausible because Jira external-write authority is environment-configured and no explicit destination allowlist is represented; it is not classified as a false positive here.

agreements: One Pydantic AI principal and its single read-only search tool are recovered.
No state-changing or broad-network finding is emitted for a source-constrained Brave/Reddit workflow.

recurring_gap_families.description: Entities are often discovered, but source-proven per-agent bindings through FastAgent server lists, imported list composition, and custom MCP model/tool loops are lost.
User ingress reaches an agent and state/checkpoint mutation, but PATH construction is absent. rw-165 is confirmed; rw-071 depends on MemorySaver semantics.
Remote MCP no-auth evidence and model-selected URL destinations are not fully converted into policy findings.
AGT053 can be emitted without an effective agent binding even though the documented rule is specifically bound-MCP authority.
Dynamic agent factory instances can collapse into one structural principal; low immediate security impact without privileged authority.

next_build_order: Fix reusable authority-binding primitives first: imported tool-list composition, FastAgent per-agent MCP binding, custom MCP model/tool-loop binding.
Add CLI/Streamlit trust propagation only where source proves the concrete agent invocation and privileged/state sink.
Improve authentication/destination evidence extraction for custom remote MCP and URL-taking function tools.
Reconcile AGT053 implementation with its documented bound-MCP contract before expanding more MCP heuristics.
Rerun this frozen 11-case cohort and the full Frozen-180 precision gates after each tranche.
